name: G-Tech Info Training Ltd
about:
Incorporated in 1994, G-tech Info 
Training Ltd is in the business of 
Computer training and KPO /BPO 
Outsourcing Services[1]
keyPoints:
Services Offered:[1][2]
a) GTITL provides Computer training and KPO /BPO Outsourcing Services
b) It services all brands of computers, laptop, tab, hardware & software etc.
c) Company is low cost specialist repair services for all brands of laptop/iPod & notebook in western 
part of India
d) It is in process of tie-up with various e-commerce/on-line portals to trade their products through the Company platform, thus penetrating into Tier II & Tier III towns in India

cons: Stock is trading at 37.7 times its book value
Company has low interest coverage ratio.
Company has a low return on equity of 9.38% over last 3 years.
